description: Evaluation set over a 3-document corpus: the Northwind annual report (which every question targets) plus two distractors — a competitor's annual report with deliberately parallel structure and different figures, and a sector review sharing the same vocabulary. Retrieval must therefore discriminate by source, not merely by topic. Every question names Northwind explicitly, because the distractors report the same metrics; an unqualified question would be genuinely ambiguous and would penalise retrieval for a flaw in the dataset rather than the system. Each answerable question declares the exact spans required, making retrieval metrics deterministic and free. Unanswerable questions carry no spans and measure refusal instead of invention.
